verdict.rationale: ELSTER gives indirect status signals rather than a status lookup. A transmission protocol (Übertragungsprotokoll) is produced after a successful VAT pre-return submission. Behind the Mein ELSTER login, users can retrieve outcome documents such as the W-IdNr notification letter and electronic tax assessments, and read messages in the inbox. None of this is a status lookup on public pages, and the public status page covers server availability only, not filing status. missing for 10: a public-facing filing/application/case status lookup, an explicit status tracker for submitted forms (e.g. tax-number registration questionnaire), independent or hands-on corroboration.
